ja: シリウス: 彼女の言うことを聞け、坊や。

ja: シリウス: あれはいつも期待を裏切らんな。

en: At least I get revenge on someone today.

key: For that is the way that she makes it turn.
en: For that is the way that she makes it turn.
ja: 彼女がそう回るように仕向けているからだ。

key: HARDY: I ain't gonna let that happen...
en: HARDY: I ain't gonna let that happen...
ja: ハーディ: そんなことさせねえ…

key: SIRIUS: We do not require your permission.
en: SIRIUS: We do not require your permission.
ja: シリウス: 貴様の許可など必要ない。

key: TITANIA: Like I said before, there's only one person here who is capable of doing anything about this.
en: TITANIA: Like I said before, there's only one person here who is capable of doing anything about this.
ja: ティタニア: さっきも言ったけど、ここでこの状況をどうにかできるのは一人だけ。

key: And she's already given up.
en: And she's already given up.
ja: そしてその人は、もう諦めてる。

key: AYA: W-wait, do you mean...
en: AYA: W-wait, do you mean...
ja: アヤ: ちょ、待って、それって…

key: TITANIA: Yes, you.
en: TITANIA: Yes, you.
ja: ティタニア: ええ、あなたのこと。

key: AYA: What do you expect me to do?
en: AYA: What do you expect me to do?
ja: アヤ: わたしに何をしろっていうの?

key: I'm the hostage here!
en: I'm the hostage here!
ja: わたしはここじゃ人質なんだけど!

key: TITANIA: Frankly, I expect you to continue being useless.
en: TITANIA: Frankly, I expect you to continue being useless.
ja: ティタニア: 正直、あなたにはこのまま役立たずでいてほしいと思ってる。

key: But if we set expectations aside, I'd say you could actually work towards finding a way out of the situation yourself,
en: But if we set expectations aside, I'd say you could actually work towards finding a way out of the situation yourself,
ja: でも期待の話は置いといて、あなたは自分でこの状況から抜け出す方法を探すこともできるはず、

key: Instead of just waiting to be rescued like a storybook damsel.
en: Instead of just waiting to be rescued like a storybook damsel.
ja: おとぎ話のお姫様みたいに助けを待ってるだけじゃなくてね。

key: But you've already resigned yourself to the label of helpless prisoner.
en: But you've already resigned yourself to the label of helpless prisoner.
ja: でもあなたはもう、無力な囚われ人ってレッテルに甘んじてる。

key: And there's nothing any of us can do about that,
en: And there's nothing any of us can do about that,
ja: それについては、あたしたちの誰にもどうにもできない、

key: No matter how much some of us may think we want to.
en: No matter how much some of us may think we want to.
ja: たとえ何とかしたいと思ってる人がいたとしてもね。

key: HARDY: What do you mean "think" we want to?
en: HARDY: What do you mean "think" we want to?
ja: ハーディ: 『思ってる』ってどういう意味だよ?

key: Of course I wanna help her!
en: Of course I wanna help her!
ja: 俺は本気で彼女を助けたいんだ!

key: But...
en: But...
ja: でも…

key: TITANIA: But you can't, and your motivations are skewed.
en: TITANIA: But you can't, and your motivations are skewed.
ja: ティタニア: でもあなたにはできない。しかも動機自体がゆがんでる。

key: End of discussion.
en: End of discussion.
ja: 話は終わり。

key: AYA: I...
en: AYA: I...
ja: アヤ: わたし…

key: Uh...
en: Uh...
ja: えっと…

key: I don't--
en: I don't--
ja: わたしは――

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うう…

key: HARDY: AYA!!!
en: HARDY: AYA!!!
ja: ハーディ: アヤ!!!

key: SIRIUS: What? What are you doing?
en: SIRIUS: What? What are you doing?
ja: シリウス: 何だ? 何をしている?

key: Get up!
en: Get up!
ja: 起きろ!

key: TITANIA: By the way, how long have you been down here with her?
en: TITANIA: By the way, how long have you been down here with her?
ja: ティタニア: ところで、彼女とここに一体どれくらいいるの?

key: SIRIUS: Since Lin ordered us to-- What does it matter?!
en: SIRIUS: Since Lin ordered us to-- What does it matter?!
ja: シリウス: リンに命じられてからだ――それが何だというのだ?!

key: TITANIA: And when was the last time you gave her any water?
en: TITANIA: And when was the last time you gave her any water?
ja: ティタニア: 最後に水をあげたのはいつ?

key: SIRIUS: What?
en: SIRIUS: What?
ja: シリウス: 何?

key: TITANIA: Amazing.
en: TITANIA: Amazing.
ja: ティタニア: あきれた。

key: HARDY: Sis, what are you saying?!
en: HARDY: Sis, what are you saying?!
ja: ハーディ: 姉貴、何言ってんだ?!

key: TITANIA: I'm saying that this man is an idiot.
en: TITANIA: I'm saying that this man is an idiot.
ja: ティタニア: この男は馬鹿だって言ってるの。

key: A hostage won't do you much good if you can't even keep her alive.
en: A hostage won't do you much good if you can't even keep her alive.
ja: 生かしておくことすらできないなら、人質なんて何の役にも立たない。

key: HARDY: What?!
en: HARDY: What?!
ja: ハーディ: 何だと?!

key: TITANIA: It's heat exhaustion.
en: TITANIA: It's heat exhaustion.
ja: ティタニア: 熱中症よ。

key: She's been cooped up down here next to this lava without adequate water for so long that she passed out.
en: She's been cooped up down here next to this lava without adequate water for so long that she passed out.
ja: この溶岩のそばに、十分な水もなく長時間閉じ込められて、それで気を失った。

key: If she's not treated quickly, she'll die.
en: If she's not treated quickly, she'll die.
ja: 早く手当てしないと死ぬわよ。

key: HARDY: Then we gotta do something!
en: HARDY: Then we gotta do something!
ja: ハーディ: なら何とかしねえと!

key: TITANIA: So what will you do now, Sirius?
en: TITANIA: So what will you do now, Sirius?
ja: ティタニア: それで、これからどうするの、シリウス?

key: You can no longer stall us out with your living shield.
en: You can no longer stall us out with your living shield.
ja: もう生きた盾で時間稼ぎはできない。

key: On our parts, both action and inaction lead to her loss.
en: On our parts, both action and inaction lead to her loss.
ja: あたしたちにとっては、動いても動かなくても、彼女を失うことに変わりはない。

key: We no longer have any reason not to tear you to pieces.
en: We no longer have any reason not to tear you to pieces.
ja: だから、あんたを八つ裂きにしない理由なんて、もうどこにもない。

key: \PN? You seem like you could use some excitement.
en: \PN? You seem like you could use some excitement.
ja: \PN? ちょっと発散したい気分でしょ。

key: SIRIUS: Pah.
en: SIRIUS: Pah.
ja: シリウス: フン。

key: As if I ever truly needed her.
en: As if I ever truly needed her.
ja: そもそも彼女など、本当に必要だったことなどない。

key: I'll defeat all of you myself if I must!
en: I'll defeat all of you myself if I must!
ja: 必要とあらば、貴様ら全員、私一人で倒してみせる!

key: For the new world!
en: For the new world!
ja: 新世界のために!

key: Do you know what regret like that does to a person?
en: Do you know what regret like that does to a person?
ja: その種の後悔が　人を　どう変えるか　貴様に分かるか?

key: SIRIUS: I've done all I could to erase the mistakes I've scrawled on history.
en: SIRIUS: I've done all I could to erase the mistakes I've scrawled on history.
ja: シリウス: 歴史に刻んだ過ちを消し去るため、私はできる限りのことをしてきた。

key: How do you expect me to live with my myriad sins?
en: How do you expect me to live with my myriad sins?
ja: この無数の罪を抱えて、私にどう生きろというのだ?

key: SAPHIRA: I don't.
en: SAPHIRA: I don't.
ja: サファイラ: 生きろとは言わない。

key: SAPHIRA: Live by fire; die by fire.
en: SAPHIRA: Live by fire; die by fire.
ja: サファイラ: 火に生き、火に死ぬ。

key: SIRIUS: Ha-- Too true--
en: SIRIUS: Ha-- Too true--
ja: シリウス: ハ――まったくその通りだ――

key: This is a fitting place... for me to--
en: This is a fitting place... for me to--
ja: ここはふさわしい場所だ…私が――

key: AYA: So... that's it?
en: AYA: So... that's it?
ja: アヤ: それで…終わり?

key: SAPHIRA: Seems so.
en: SAPHIRA: Seems so.
ja: サファイラ: そのようね。

key: SIRIUS: You!
en: SIRIUS: You!
ja: シリウス: 貴様!

key: Hah-- Too true--
en: Hah-- Too true--
ja: ハ――まったくその通りだ――

key: TITANIA: We heard you had a little tumble, but you seem to be well.
en: TITANIA: We heard you had a little tumble, but you seem to be well.
ja: ティタニア: ちょっと転んだって聞いたけど、元気そうね。

key: SAPHIRA: I said before...
en: SAPHIRA: I said before...
ja: サファイラ: 前にも言った通り…

key: I may be down, but I'm never out.
en: I may be down, but I'm never out.
ja: 倒れることはあっても、負けることはない。

key: TITANIA: Unlike some.
en: TITANIA: Unlike some.
ja: ティタニア: 誰かさんとは違ってね。

key: SAPHIRA: I found a way back in and heard about what he did.
en: SAPHIRA: I found a way back in and heard about what he did.
ja: サファイラ: 戻る道を見つけて、あの男がしたことを聞いたわ。

key: I'm glad to have been able to take revenge on at least one person.
en: I'm glad to have been able to take revenge on at least one person.
ja: 少なくとも一人にはふくしゅうできて良かった。

key: TITANIA: As if that meant anything.
en: TITANIA: As if that meant anything.
ja: ティタニア: それに何の意味があるんだか。

key: SAPHIRA: Right.
en: SAPHIRA: Right.
ja: サファイラ: そうね。

key: Now if you'll excuse me, I have a sibling to console.
en: Now if you'll excuse me, I have a sibling to console.
ja: では失礼するわ、慰めなきゃいけない妹弟がいるから。

key: HARDY: You're okay, right?
en: HARDY: You're okay, right?
ja: ハーディ: 大丈夫か?

key: HARDY: You're awake!
en: HARDY: You're awake!
ja: ハーディ: 目を覚ましたか!

key: AYA: Y-yeah.
en: AYA: Y-yeah.
ja: アヤ: う、うん。

key: HARDY: Are you okay? I'll find you some water, stat!
en: HARDY: Are you okay? I'll find you some water, stat!
ja: ハーディ: 大丈夫か? すぐ水持ってくる!

key: AYA: It's fine, really...
en: AYA: It's fine, really...
ja: アヤ: 平気だから、本当に…

key: TITANIA: She was just faking the collapse.
en: TITANIA: She was just faking the collapse.
ja: ティタニア: あれ、気絶したふりだったのよ。

key: HARDY: Say what?!
en: HARDY: Say what?!
ja: ハーディ: は?!

key: AYA: She told me to try and do something myself to fix it, so I...
en: AYA: She told me to try and do something myself to fix it, so I...
ja: アヤ: 自分で何とかしてみろって言われたから、それで…

key: I didn't know what else to do.
en: I didn't know what else to do.
ja: 他にどうしたらいいかわからなかった。

key: TITANIA: No points for still casting yourself as the victim in it, but it worked.
en: TITANIA: No points for still casting yourself as the victim in it, but it worked.
ja: ティタニア: それでもまだ自分を被害者に見立ててる点は減点だけど、効果はあった。

key: HARDY: An' you knew?
en: HARDY: An' you knew?
ja: ハーディ: それ、知っててやったのか?

key: TITANIA: It was obvious.
en: TITANIA: It was obvious.
ja: ティタニア: 見え見えだったわ。

key: So I came up with a pretext for it.
en: So I came up with a pretext for it.
ja: だから、それらしい口実を考えてあげたの。

key: But I'll admit that your oblivious panic helped sell it.
en: But I'll admit that your oblivious panic helped sell it.
ja: でも、あなたの何も気づかないパニックが、真実味を出すのに役立ったのは認めるわ。

key: HARDY: Gee, thanks.
en: HARDY: Gee, thanks.
ja: ハーディ: どうも、ご丁寧に。

key: But you're really okay, then.
en: But you're really okay, then.
ja: でも、じゃあ本当に大丈夫なんだな。

key: AYA: Yeah, I'm... fine.
en: AYA: Yeah, I'm... fine.
ja: アヤ: うん、わたしは…平気。

key: I could use some food... or a nap.
en: I could use some food... or a nap.
ja: 何か食べたいかも…あと、少し眠りたい。

key: Or, for that matter, a shower.
en: Or, for that matter, a shower.
ja: それか、シャワーとか。

key: A really, really long shower...
en: A really, really long shower...
ja: 本当に、本当に長いシャワー…

key: HARDY: I'll get you outta here.
en: HARDY: I'll get you outta here.
ja: ハーディ: ここから連れ出してやる。

key: HARDY: Then let's get you outta here.
en: HARDY: Then let's get you outta here.
ja: ハーディ: じゃあ、ここから連れ出してやろう。

key: Everything's gonna be okay from now on.
en: Everything's gonna be okay from now on.
ja: これからはもう、全部大丈夫だ。

key: Or...
en: Or...
ja: って、それか…

key: AYA: ...What's the matter?
en: AYA: ...What's the matter?
ja: アヤ: …どうしたの?

key: HARDY: I just...
en: HARDY: I just...
ja: ハーディ: ただ…

key: I guess I dunno if I should be sayin' that kinda thing anymore.
en: I guess I dunno if I should be sayin' that kinda thing anymore.
ja: 俺がまだそういうこと言っていいのか、わかんなくなってきた。

key: For all my big talk about rescuing you, I wasn't able to.
en: For all my big talk about rescuing you, I wasn't able to.
ja: 散々救うって言っといて、結局俺にはできなかった。

key: Honestly, I feel pretty lame right now.
en: Honestly, I feel pretty lame right now.
ja: 正直、今めちゃくちゃかっこ悪い気分だ。

key: So who am I to assume I'm anyone who could take care of you?
en: So who am I to assume I'm anyone who could take care of you?
ja: だから、俺なんかがお前の面倒見られるなんて、何様のつもりだったんだろうな。

key: I failed.
en: I failed.
ja: 俺は失敗した。

key: An' that's that.
en: An' that's that.
ja: それだけの話だ。

key: AYA: Yeah, you... really did.
en: AYA: Yeah, you... really did.
ja: アヤ: うん、本当に…失敗したね。

key: HARDY: Thanks.
en: HARDY: Thanks.
ja: ハーディ: どうも。

key: AYA: No, it's okay.
en: AYA: No, it's okay.
ja: アヤ: ううん、いいの。

key: In the end, I'm fine.
en: In the end, I'm fine.
ja: 結局、わたしは大丈夫だから。

key: But I hear what you're saying.
en: But I hear what you're saying.
ja: でも、言いたいことはわかる。

key: And I know the feeling.
en: And I know the feeling.
ja: その気持ち、わたしも知ってる。

key: I live with it all the time.
en: I live with it all the time.
ja: わたしはずっとそれを抱えて生きてる。

key: Honestly, right now you sound as self-deprecating as me.
en: Honestly, right now you sound as self-deprecating as me.
ja: 正直、今のあなた、わたしと同じくらい自己卑下してる。

key: But I think I'm glad it happened this way.
en: But I think I'm glad it happened this way.
ja: でも、こうなって良かったと思ってる。

key: I guess I shouldn't say that kinda thing anymore.
en: I guess I shouldn't say that kinda thing anymore.
ja: そういうこと、もう言わない方がいいのかな。

key: Maybe it's just like she said.
en: Maybe it's just like she said.
ja: たぶん、あの人が言った通りなんだと思う。

key: I was just deluding myself into thinking I could be some kind of hero for you.
en: I was just deluding myself into thinking I could be some kind of hero for you.
ja: わたしがお前にとってヒーローになれるなんて、ただの自己ぎまんだったんだろうな。

key: AYA: Well...
en: AYA: Well...
ja: アヤ: それって…

key: Is that so bad?
en: Is that so bad?
ja: そんなに悪いこと?

key: One way or another, I'm safe.
en: One way or another, I'm safe.
ja: どんな形にせよ、わたしは無事なんだから。

key: And for the record, I don't think she's right about that.
en: And for the record, I don't think she's right about that.
ja: それに、念のため言っておくけど、あの人が正しいとは思わない。

key: Even before I was taken, you were the only one who really seemed to care about me.
en: Even before I was taken, you were the only one who really seemed to care about me.
ja: 連れ去られる前から、本当にわたしを気にかけてくれてたのはあなただけだった。

key: And regardless of the reasons, you didn't give up.
en: And regardless of the reasons, you didn't give up.
ja: 理由が何であれ、あなたは諦めなかった。

key: Somehow, you're even still here now.
en: Somehow, you're even still here now.
ja: しかも、今もまだこうしてここにいる。

key: In a sense, I'm glad it happened this way.
en: In a sense, I'm glad it happened this way.
ja: ある意味、こうなって良かったと思う。

key: If you had actually been the one to save me, and then tried to stick around and help me like before, I'd just feel like I didn't even come close to deserving you.
en: If you had actually been the one to save me, and then tried to stick around and help me like before, I'd just feel like I didn't even come close to deserving you.
ja: もしあなたが本当にわたしを救い出して、前みたいにそばにいて助けようとしてくれたら、わたしはあなたにふさわしいなんて、とても思えなかったはず。

key: I still... don't really know if I do, but...
en: I still... don't really know if I do, but...
ja: 今でも…本当にそうなのかわからないけど…

key: Uh, what I'm trying to say is...
en: Uh, what I'm trying to say is...
ja: えっと、言いたいのは…

key: It's easier for me this way.
en: It's easier for me this way.
ja: こういう形の方が、わたしには楽なの。

key: In the end, you're still the one who always cared about me.
en: In the end, you're still the one who always cared about me.
ja: 結局、いつもわたしを気にかけてくれてたのは、やっぱりあなただった。

key: And you're still the one who's here for me.
en: And you're still the one who's here for me.
ja: そして今もそばにいてくれるのは、やっぱりあなた。

key: It's not like I'm actually worth anything... but...
en: It's not like I'm actually worth anything... but...
ja: わたしに本当に価値があるわけじゃないだろうけど…でも…

key: I'm glad to have you.
en: I'm glad to have you.
ja: あなたがいてくれて良かった。

key: So, thanks.
en: So, thanks.
ja: だから、ありがとう。

key: HARDY: Hah.
en: HARDY: Hah.
ja: ハーディ: はは。

key: I dunno what to say to that, but,
en: I dunno what to say to that, but,
ja: 何て言えばいいかわかんねえけど、

key: In the end, I think we'll make a pretty good team.
en: In the end, I think we'll make a pretty good team.
ja: 結局、俺たちなかなかいいチームになれる気がするよ。

key: Though, uh...
en: Though, uh...
ja: でも、あー…

key: If you're gonna talk about still being here...
en: If you're gonna talk about still being here...
ja: まだここにいるって話をするなら…

key: AYA: Huh?
en: AYA: Huh?
ja: アヤ: え?

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: あ。

key: Yeah.
en: Yeah.
ja: うん。

key: Well...
en: Well...
ja: その…

key: It's not the same, okay?
en: It's not the same, okay?
ja: 同じってわけじゃないから、いい?

key: Um, but... Yeah, thanks for your help, \PN.
en: Um, but... Yeah, thanks for your help, \PN.
ja: えっと、でも…うん、\PN、助けてくれてありがとう。

key: HARDY: To be fair, I coulda taken Sirius too.
en: HARDY: To be fair, I coulda taken Sirius too.
ja: ハーディ: 正直言うと、シリウスくらい俺だって倒せたと思うぜ。

key: But I guess I missed my chance.
en: But I guess I missed my chance.
ja: まあ、チャンスを逃しただけだけどな。

key: So thanks from me too, mate.
en: So thanks from me too, mate.
ja: だから俺からもありがとう、相棒。

key: AYA: Yeah, yeah, okay, now stop.
en: AYA: Yeah, yeah, okay, now stop.
ja: アヤ: うん、うん、はいはい、もうやめて。

key: You're gonna ruin the moment.
en: You're gonna ruin the moment.
ja: せっかくのいい雰囲気が台無しになる。

key: HARDY: Any moment's pro'ly best had somewhere else.
en: HARDY: Any moment's pro'ly best had somewhere else.
ja: ハーディ: どんな雰囲気にしろ、たぶん他の場所の方がいいよな。

key: What do you say we get outta here?
en: What do you say we get outta here?
ja: そろそろここから出ようぜ。

key: So thanks for not giving up on me.
en: So thanks for not giving up on me.
ja: だから、わたしを見捨てないでいてくれてありがとう。

key: Or you.
en: Or you.
ja: あなたにもね。

key: Or... us?
en: Or... us?
ja: それか…わたしたちに?

key: HARDY: "Us" ... sounds pretty good.
en: HARDY: "Us" ... sounds pretty good.
ja: ハーディ: 『俺たち』…いい響きだな。

key: I can do that.
en: I can do that.
ja: それなら任せとけ。

key: TITANIA: Well, I can't say I approve, but...
en: TITANIA: Well, I can't say I approve, but...
ja: ティタニア: まあ、賛成とは言えないけど…

key: HARDY: Listen, sis, regardless of what you think, if this is what we wanna do, isn't that our right?
en: HARDY: Listen, sis, regardless of what you think, if this is what we wanna do, isn't that our right?
ja: ハーディ: なあ姉貴、お前がどう思おうと、これが俺たちの望むことなら、それは俺たちの権利だろ?

key: TITANIA: Naturally.
en: TITANIA: Naturally.
ja: ティタニア: 当然ね。

key: TITANIA: Aya, right?
en: TITANIA: Aya, right?
ja: ティタニア: アヤ、だったわね?

key: AYA: Yeah...?
en: AYA: Yeah...?
ja: アヤ: うん…?

key: TITANIA: We'll be in touch.
en: TITANIA: We'll be in touch.
ja: ティタニア: また連絡するわ。

key: AYA: Uhhhhh...
en: AYA: Uhhhhh...
ja: アヤ: え、えぇ…

key: HARDY: Oh boy.
en: HARDY: Oh boy.
ja: ハーディ: おいおい。

key: Don't worry about it for now, aite?
en: Don't worry about it for now, aite?
ja: とりあえず気にすんな、な?

key: We'll figure it out.
en: We'll figure it out.
ja: 何とかなるさ。

key: For now, whaddya say we get outta here?
en: For now, whaddya say we get outta here?
ja: とりあえず、そろそろここから出ようぜ。

key: AYA: I say 'please'.
en: AYA: I say 'please'.
ja: アヤ: 『お願い』って言うわ。

key: HARDY: That's that, then.
en: HARDY: That's that, then.
ja: ハーディ: じゃあ決まりだな。

key: We'll be rollin' out too.
en: We'll be rollin' out too.
ja: 俺たちも出発するよ。

key: Gotta take care of her best I can, yanno?
en: Gotta take care of her best I can, yanno?
ja: できる限り彼女の面倒を見なきゃいけねえからな。

key: Thanks for your help with her, and everything else, \PN.
en: Thanks for your help with her, and everything else, \PN.
ja: 彼女のことも、他のことも、助けてくれてありがとな、\PN。

key: I'm trustin' you to take care of the rest of Team Meteor for me, aite?
en: I'm trustin' you to take care of the rest of Team Meteor for me, aite?
ja: 残りのチームメテオはお前に任せるからな、いいか?

key: I know you'll rock 'em as always!
en: I know you'll rock 'em as always!
ja: いつも通り、ぶちのめしてくれるって信じてるぜ!
